suppress.notes:
CVE-2026-66299 affects only Apache Tomcat's optional WebSocket chat example. WhatsAnki embeds tomcat-embed-core and tomcat-embed-websocket 11.0.24 and packages no Tomcat examples application or WebSocket chat example. Apache's vendor advisory explicitly says deployments without the examples web application are unaffected.
Tracking: replace Tomcat 11.0.24 with 11.0.25 or later when released, then remove this suppression. Vendor advisory: https://lists.apache.org/thread/8owczcc1o8qw1rxmg9gvfk4w2jnh4l5k
